title: vercel-labs/vgpu: one WebGPU toolkit for graphics, tensors and browser AI
friendlyTitle: vgpu makes browser graphics and AI GPU work easier to build
summary: vgpu is an MIT-licensed, cross-runtime WebGPU library covering shaders, scenes, compute, GPU tensors and neural-network interoperability across browsers and Node. The active project includes typed APIs, command-line tooling and examples that keep model outputs on the GPU.
friendlySummary: This open-source library gives developers one set of tools for WebGPU graphics, maths and neural-network data in browsers and Node.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to prototype browser-side AI visualization or GPU compute without assembling every low-level WebGPU layer themselves. Check browser support and benchmark real hardware before depending on it for production inference.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can speed up experiments with AI that runs or displays results on a user’s GPU. Test device support before shipping it.
